etherCSBig04.desc: Increased chance to roll for chase items when Cursed Spirit dies.

etherCSBig07.label: Borrowed Time
etherCSBig07.desc: Increased Cursed Spirit duration when popping a pustule. Pustules no longer cleanse the corrupted ground and monsters gain an additional affix.

etherCSSmall05.label: Tomb Raider
etherCSSmall05.desc: Increased chance to roll for chase items when Cursed Spirit dies.

etherCSSmall06.desc: Magic Find added to Cursed Spirit per popped pustule.

etherCtBig03.label: Amplified Magic Find
etherCtBig03.desc: Increased total Magic Find applied to the Chaos Tower chest

etherDngBig05.label: Midas Touch
etherDngBig05.desc: Midas Touch Gold Find. All items dropped by the Dungeon chest below Heroic rarity are transformed into gold, with an unmodifiable gold find bonus.

etherDngBig06.label: Unstable Alchemy
etherDngBig06.desc: Alchemy Gold Find. All items dropped by the Dungeon chest are transformed into gold, with an unmodifiable gold find bonus.

etherDngBig07.label: Devil’s Gamble
etherDngBig07.desc: Chance for Dungeon chests to replace Satanic item drops with Satanic Dice

etherDngSmall05.label: Bloating Treasure Chests
etherDngSmall05.desc: Increased Magic Find when opening chests.

etherDngSmall06.label: Challenging Treasure Chests
etherDngSmall06.desc: Increased Loot Amount when opening the Challenge Dungeon reward Chest.

etherDngSmall07.label: Key to Satanism
etherDngSmall07.desc: Dungeon chests have a 3% chance to replace a Satanic item with Satanic Dice

etherEBBig06.label: Dishonored Samurai
etherEBBig06.desc: Eternal Battlefield may be guarded by Forsaken Ronin.

etherEBBig07.label: Prophet of War
etherEBBig07.desc: Eternal Battlefield may be attacked by Sung Lee’s Herald.

etherEBBig08.label: Eternal Treasure Vault
etherEBBig08.desc: to Eternal Battlefield monster Loot Amount, but Battle Fragments no longer drop.

etherEBBig09.label: Mirror of Eternity
etherEBBig09.desc: Chance to spawn an additional Eternal Battlefield portal in the zone.

etherEBBig10.label: Battle in the Horizon
etherEBBig10.desc: Increased Eternal Battlefield portal discovery radius.

etherEBSmall07.label: Foretold
etherEBSmall07.desc: Increased chance for Eternal Battlefield monsters to drop Gypsy’s Prophecy.

etherEBSmall08.label: Spoils of Eternal War
etherEBSmall08.desc: Chance for Eternal Battlefield monsters to have +1 to Loot Amount

etherEBSmall09.label: Emerging Battle
etherEBSmall09.desc: Increased Eternal Battlefield portal discovery radius.

etherMinBig07.label: 49’er
etherMinBig07.desc: Chance for nodes to spawn as Rich or Overflowing.

etherMinBig08.label: Gifts from Valhalla
etherMinBig08.desc: Chance for nodes to spawn as Asgardian veins.

etherMinSmall01.label: Gold Rush
etherMinSmall01.desc: Chance for an ore node to spawn additional node next to it

etherMinSmall09.label: Worthy
etherMinSmall09.desc: Chance to summon a portal to Asgard when mining a Rich or Overflowing node.

etherOwBig05.label: Ready to Pop

etherOwBig08.label: Corrupted Divinity
etherOwBig08.desc: Chance for Colossal Chest mosters to spawn with the Divine affix

etherOwBig09.label: Fallen Guardians
etherOwBig09.desc: Chance for additional monsters to become Fallen. Additional monsters are always at least Legions.

etherOwBig10.label: Flesh Golem
etherOwBig10.desc: Chance for Ancient monsters in a zone with Colossal Chest to be spawned as an Abomination.

etherOwBig11.label: Hellsmith
etherOwBig11.desc: to Additional Colossal Chest rolls for Blacksmith’s Mallet

etherOwSmall06.label: Swarm
etherOwSmall06.desc: Chance to double the amount of Colossal Chest monsters.

etherOwSmall07.label: Hidden Compartment
etherOwSmall07.desc: Chance to open the Colossal Chest an additional time.

etherOwSmall08.label: Bloated Reward
etherOwSmall08.desc: to Colossal Chest monster Magic Find

etherOwSmall09.label: Guardians of the Coven
etherOwSmall09.desc: Chance to spawn an additional monster pack with each Colossal Chest monster.

etherPeBig06.label: Infernal Ascendancy
etherPeBig06.desc: Chance for monsters to spawn as higher rarity within Boss Dungeons.

etherPeBig07.label: Key to Damnation
etherPeBig07.desc: Bosses have a high chance of dropping Chaos Keys.

etherPeSmall05.label: Infernal Bodyguards
etherPeSmall05.desc: to Monster Pack Size within of Boss Dungeons.

etherPeSmall06.label: Skeleton Key
etherPeSmall06.desc: Increased Chaos Key drop chance within Boss Dungeons.

etherRgBig04.label: Entry to the Garden
etherRgBig04.desc: Increased Chance to drop Ruby Keys.

etherRgBig05.label: Wrath of Endrixia
etherRgBig05.desc: Ruby Chests in Overworld have a chance to spawn Endrixia, but she no longer spawns in Ruby Gardens.

etherRgSmall05.label: Ruby Keys
etherRgSmall05.desc: Increased Chance to drop Ruby Keys.

etherRgSmall06.label: Dragonic Chests
etherRgSmall06.desc: Chance for Chests in overworld to spawn as Ruby Chests, but Ruby Gardens no longer has Ruby Chests in it.

etherSRSmall05.label: Darker Shadows
etherSRSmall05.desc: Chance for monsters in Shadow Realm to spawn as higher rarity.

etherUSBig03.label: Strange Encounters
etherUSBig03.desc: More likely Unholy Sieges have Special Invaders.

etherUSBig04.label: Mimicry
etherUSBig04.desc: Increased chance for Unholy Siege to contain Mimics.

etherUSBig05.label: Dimensional Breach
etherUSBig05.desc: Chance to warp reality when activating Unholy Siege, spewing forth armies of unspeakable horrors.

etherUSBig07.label: Divine Steve
etherUSBig07.desc: Stickmans from Unholy Siege have a very small chance of dropping Divine Cards.

etherUSBig08.label: Deck of Cards
etherUSBig08.desc: Chance for Tarot Cards from Unholy Siege to drop as Tarot Decks.

etherUSBig09.label: Everlasting Siege
etherUSBig09.desc: Increased chance to spawn an Unholy Siege in the map.

etherUSBig10.label: Hazard no More
etherUSBig10.desc: Hazards are removed from Unholy Siege but monsters gain 2 additional affixes and increased life.

etherUSSmall05.label: Empowered Invaders
etherUSSmall05.desc: Increased chance for Unholy Siege monsters to spawn as higher rarity.

etherUSSmall06.label: Empowered Sieging
etherUSSmall06.desc: Increased chance to spawn an Unholy Siege in the map.

etherUrBig07.label: Warp to Sheeponia
etherUrBig07.desc: Chance to warp to Sheeponia when entering Unstable Rift.

etherUrBig08.label: Warp to Hell
etherUrBig08.desc: Chance to warp to Arch Demon’s Plateau when entering Unstable Rift.

etherUrBig09.label: Warp to Heaven
etherUrBig09.desc: Chance to warp to Angelic Realm when entering Unstable Rift.

etherUrBig10.label: Unstable Destiny
etherUrBig10.desc: Chance for Unstable Dust drops to convert into Destiny Shards.
